newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE March white sugar takes late tumble at expir.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE March white sugar takes late tumble at expir.

text.p: London's March white sugar contract took a late tumble as it went off the board at close of business on Thursday, causing the nearby spread to contract by some $5.00 in the space of two sessions.
One trade house was said to be a larger-scale bidder of the spread at the lower levels, while another was an active seller and caused it to narrow further.
But scale-down buyers were also lurking under the market to pick up bargains, traders said.
The March contract expired at $302.90, down $2.00 on the day. Earlier it hit an intraday high of $305.50.
May was unchanged at $301.50 and total volume amounted to 1,942 lots.
Traders said they expected as much as three cargoes of white sugar to be delivered against the contract, mainly from the European Union but possibly also Poland.
